Grace / team — attaching a working CSV with our current roster and a preliminary country column. Notes: 
- CDN/edge partners (EdgeFlow, Nimbus CDN) may cache short-lived request bodies in region-specific POPs; those are transient and not persisted as customer backups.
- Monitoring/observability vendors (TraceStack) receive telemetry from our hosted control plane in the US and EU; for EU customers we route through EU-only endpoints where possible.
- Backup/archive providers (Vaultary) replicate encrypted backups across us-west and eu-west; encryption keys are customer-specific when required per contract.
